reference.title: Activation Function Optimization Scheme for Image Classification

implementation_notes: Loaded by run_paper.py; main.py remains the legacy experiment.
Seeds 0..4, dropout 0.2, split seed 1234, normalization /255 and no augmentation are explicit implementation assumptions.

Fig. 2(a-c) shapes (3, 5, 7 genes) and depth <=2 are used: the text's two core units conflicts with Fig. 2(c)'s three binary nodes. 11^3 * 19^4 exceeds 170 million, consistent with the claimed search space.
Table 2 is authoritative: first Conv has 28 filters; no extra Dense layers; the output Dense uses softmax as in Fig. 1.
Single-point crossover samples type-valid cuts including 0. Unequal-length binary-first encodings may only permit whole-parent exchange. Cut sampling details are not specified by the paper.

Ranking preserves duplicate individuals; crossover uses three independently sampled parent pairs; mutation chooses from the whole population. Operators that do not fire are replaced by random individuals.
Undefined includes NaN and infinity; no clipping changes asin/atanh domains. Softplus uses its numerically stable equivalent.
Top 15 distinct expression strings are pooled across all five searches and ranked by their best completed validation accuracy. Pooling and duplicate handling are not specified by the paper.
Post-search training retains the 45000/5000 split and uses the same optimizer settings. Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) is reported. These details are not fully specified.
This implements CIFAR-10 base-network search, retraining and baseline comparison, not the separate multi-dataset/multi-architecture generalization study.
